exposure: nonreassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR) patterns in labor
outcome: Abnormal serum creatinine levels in the perinatal period
cohort: 256 fetuses with a prenatal diagnosis of congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract (CAKUT)
finding: Nonreassuring fetal heart rate patterns during labor and delivery did not impair neonatal renal function status in fetuses diagnosed prenatally with low- and high-risk CAKUT.
mod_finding: The study found that nonreassuring fetal heart rate patterns during labor did not have a negative impact on neonatal renal function in fetuses prenatally diagnosed with congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract, suggesting that delivery decisions can be made based on standard obstetrical guidelines.
